title: Gene Editing as a Therapeutic Approach for Rett Syndrome
official: Personalized MECP2 Gene Therapy Using CRISPR/Cas9 Technology Coupled to AAV-mediated Delivery in 3D Cell Culture and KI Mice
summary: We designed the project to validate CRISPR/Cas9-based gene editing combined with AAV-based delivery for correction of the most common MECP2 mutations both in vitro and in vivo.
